adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff for packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts, lines 72-89 show a direct fetch call to 'https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token' without using the refreshOAuthTokens wrapper that other integrations use. Comparing to other calendar services in the diff (Google, Office365, Lark, Zoho, etc.), they all wrap their refresh token calls with refreshOAuthTokens(). Salesforce directly calls fetch() and then uses parseRefreshTokenResponse, but skips the refreshOAuthTokens wrapper that would honor CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT. This is inconsistent with the pattern established for other integrations and means Salesforce won't use the credential sync endpoint when APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is true.
